sloka: शिखराणि महेन्द्रस्य स्थिराणि च महान्ति च ।येषु वेगम् गमिष्यामि महेन्द्र शिखरेषु अहम् ॥४-६७-३७॥
transliteration: śikharāṇi mahendrasya sthirāṇi ca mahānti ca ।yeṣu vegam gamiṣyāmi mahendra śikhareṣu aham ॥4-67-37॥

translations.english: 'The rocks on the peaks of the ranges of mount Mahendra cannot with stand it, although they are huge and firm.
